cases.situation: I run a small candle shop on Etsy. A customer just messaged saying our fig and cedar gift set arrived and her mum loved it. I'd like to ask for a review without being pushy.
cases.reply: That made my day, thank you for telling me! I'm so glad your mum liked the fig and cedar set. If you have a minute, a short review on the order page is how small shops like mine get found on Etsy. Two sentences is plenty. Thank you either way.
cases.note: Ask right after the good moment, point to one place, say how short it is, and give a real out.

cases.situation: Soy Lucía, fotógrafa freelance, y acabo de entregar las fotos de marca a una clínica dental; las hice en una mañana sin interrumpir las consultas. La directora, la doctora Ruiz, me dijo que le encantaron. Quiero pedirle un testimonio para mi web.
cases.reply: Hola doctora Ruiz, me alegra mucho que las fotos le hayan gustado. ¿Le puedo pedir un favor? Un testimonio corto, dos o tres frases, me ayudaría muchísimo con los próximos clientes. Para ponérselo fácil, le dejo un borrador que puede cambiar o reemplazar: "Lucía hizo las fotos de la clínica en una mañana, sin interrumpir las consultas, y por fin tenemos una web que se parece a nosotros." Si prefiere escribir el suyo, mejor aún. ¡Gracias!
cases.note: Para testimonios, un borrador listo para editar hace que casi todos digan que sí.

cases.situation: I run Brightline Renovations. Two weeks ago, after we renovated Tom's bathroom, I asked him for a Google review (link: https://g.page/r/brightline-renovations/review). He said 'sure, I'll do it this weekend' and nothing yet. One reminder okay?
cases.reply: Hi Tom, hope the new bathroom is treating you well. Just floating this back up in case it got buried: https://g.page/r/brightline-renovations/review. Totally fine if it's not your thing, and thanks again for having us.
cases.note: One reminder, with the link so there's zero work. If nothing after this, drop it.

cases.situation: 我是独立的钢琴老师。学生朵朵跟我学了半年，她妈妈张姐刚发消息说孩子四级考过了，弹得很稳，特别感谢我。想请她帮我推荐给身边的家长，但不想显得太功利。
cases.reply: 张姐，恭喜朵朵！这半年她练得用心，这次考得这么稳是她应得的。想跟您提个小请求：如果身边有家长也在找钢琴老师，方便的话帮我推一下微信就行，不用多介绍，一句“朵朵的老师还不错”就够了。没有合适的也完全没关系，谢谢您一直这么支持。
cases.note: 推荐请求紧跟在好消息后面，说清对方只需要做一件很小的事，再给一个真正的退路。

cases.situation: I'm Ana and I sell sourdough starter kits online. A customer, Sofia, messaged that her first loaf came out great, so I sent her our Google review link (https://g.page/r/ana-bakes/review). She replied: 'Will do! Crazy week, I'll get to it later.'
cases.reply: Thanks Sofia, no rush at all. Here's the link again so it's easy to find when you have a minute: https://g.page/r/ana-bakes/review. Enjoy the next loaf!
cases.note: 'I'll do it later' is a yes: thank them, resend the one link so there's nothing to search for, and don't set a deadline.

cases.situation: 我开家电上门维修店，叫“老陈家电维修”。李阿姨家的空调第一次没修好，我第二次上门免费换了零件，现在好了，她挺满意。想请她在美团上给个评价，但毕竟第一次出了问题，不太好意思开口。
cases.reply: 李阿姨您好，空调这两天用着还好吧？第一次没能一次修好，让您多等了一趟，谢谢您的耐心。我们是小店，美团上的评价对新客人挑师傅特别有用，如果您愿意写两句，一分钟就够，搜“老陈家电维修”就能找到。不方便也完全没关系，以后家里电器有问题直接找我。
cases.note: 出过问题又解决了的客人：先用一句话认下那次失误，再提请求，并给一个真心的退路。

cases.situation: I run a two-person bookkeeping firm. We moved a family hardware store, Hollis & Sons, off spreadsheets and their month-end close went from 12 days to 4. The owner, Gail, thanked us last week. I'd love to write it up as a case study for our website.
cases.reply: Hi Gail, getting your month-end close from 12 days down to 4 is a result we're really proud of, and I'd love to write it up as a short case study for our website. You'd approve every word before it goes live, and it would take about 20 minutes of your time on a call; Thursday 8 or Friday 9 October both work for me. If you'd rather keep the numbers private, I'm happy to call you 'a family hardware store' instead. And if it's not for you, no problem at all.
cases.note: A case study is the bigger ask: name the result, the time it costs her and her approval rights, and offer anonymity as a second out.

cases.situation: I run a mobile dog grooming van. After grooming a client's poodle, Biscuit, I texted asking for a Google review. The owner, Nina, replied that one ear looks noticeably shorter than the other. I'm in her area again Thursday afternoon and Saturday morning.
cases.reply: Thanks for telling me, Nina, and sorry, I should have caught that before I left. I'd like to even it up for free. I'm in your area Thursday afternoon and Saturday morning, would either suit Biscuit? Ignore the review request for now; let's get his ears right first.
cases.note: A complaint in reply to a review request is a support ticket: fix it first and withdraw the ask, and don't bring the review up again unless she does.

cases.situation: Tenho uma pousada pequena em Paraty, com 6 quartos. Um casal de São Paulo, a Juliana e o Pedro, fez o check-out hoje depois de 4 noites e disse que foi a melhor viagem do ano. Quero mandar uma mensagem no WhatsApp pedindo uma avaliação no Booking.
cases.reply: Juliana e Pedro, foi um prazer receber vocês! Espero que a volta para São Paulo tenha sido tranquila. Se tiverem um minutinho, uma avaliação no Booking faz muita diferença para uma pousada pequena como a nossa, é assim que novos hóspedes nos encontram. O Booking manda o link por e-mail, e duas frases já bastam. Obrigada de qualquer forma, e voltem sempre!
cases.note: Pedido no mesmo dia do check-out, uma plataforma só, quanto tempo leva e uma saída sincera.

cases.situation: 我开了家社区烘焙店。老顾客刘姐说我们的栗子蛋糕太好吃了，我顺势请她在大众点评写个评价，她笑着问'写好评有返现吗？'。平台是不允许好评返现的。
cases.reply: 哈哈刘姐，大众点评不让商家给好评返现，查到了店铺会被处罚，所以这个真给不了。您愿意的话写两句真实感受就好，一分钟的事；不写也完全没关系，谢谢您一直照顾我们生意。
cases.note: 平台禁止的激励不能给，也别换个名头给；讲清规则，重申写起来很短、不写也没关系，照样道谢。

cases.situation: Je répare des vélos à Lyon (atelier Roue Libre, lien d'avis : https://g.page/r/atelier-roue-libre/review). Une cliente, Claire, m'a dit oui pour un avis Google après la révision de son vélo cargo, mais elle m'écrit : « Avec plaisir, mais je ne sais pas du tout quoi écrire. »
cases.reply: Merci Claire ! Pas besoin d'un long texte : vous pouvez simplement dire ce qui clochait sur le vélo et comment il roule maintenant. Deux phrases, c'est parfait. Voici le lien : https://g.page/r/atelier-roue-libre/review. Et merci d'avance, quoi que vous écriviez.
cases.note: Pour un avis public, donnez des pistes plutôt qu'un texte tout fait, pour que l'avis reste dans ses mots.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance data engineer and just wrapped a four-month pipeline project for a regional bank. My contact, Priya, loved it, so I asked for a short testimonial for my site. She replied: 'I'd love to, but compliance doesn't let us publicly endorse vendors.'
cases.reply: Totally understood, Priya, and thanks for even considering it. If it's allowed on your side, would you be open to being a private reference instead? I'd only pass your name to a prospect who's close to signing, and I'd check with you first each time. Either way, it was a great four months, thank you.
cases.note: When a policy blocks a public endorsement, don't look for a workaround; offer the smaller private version once and let it go.

cases.situation: Ich habe eine kleine Terminbuchungs-Software für Physiopraxen, Termino. Frau Hoffmann von der Praxis am Stadtpark nutzt sie seit einem Jahr, die Online-Warteliste haben wir auf ihren Vorschlag gebaut, und sie hat gerade verlängert. Ich möchte sie um eine Bewertung auf Capterra bitten (Link: example.com/termino-bewerten).
cases.reply: Liebe Frau Hoffmann, vielen Dank für die Verlängerung und für Ihre vielen Hinweise im ersten Jahr, die Online-Warteliste gäbe es ohne Sie nicht. Eine kleine Bitte: Praxen, die eine Software suchen, lesen vor allem Bewertungen auf Capterra, und Ihre ehrliche Einschätzung würde uns sehr helfen. Unter example.com/termino-bewerten kommen Sie direkt zum Formular, drei oder vier Sätze reichen, das dauert etwa fünf Minuten. Wenn es gerade nicht passt, ist das völlig in Ordnung, danke Ihnen so oder so.
cases.note: B2B: bei der Verlängerung fragen, wenn der Nutzen am greifbarsten ist, und um eine ehrliche Bewertung bitten, nicht um eine gute.

cases.situation: We're a family moving company. A customer, Samuel Okafor from Leeds, emailed after Dev's crew moved him last Friday: 'Your crew handled my late wife's piano like it was their own. Thank you.' I'd love to quote it on our website, but it's personal.
cases.reply: Mr. Okafor, thank you for writing. I've passed your words on to Dev and the crew, and they meant a great deal to them. Would you be comfortable with us sharing that line on our website, so families moving something precious know they can trust us? We'd sign it 'Samuel O., Leeds' or leave your name off entirely, and we'd cut any part you'd rather keep private. If you'd prefer it stays between us, that's completely fine, and thank you again.
cases.note: Quoting a private message: ask permission, offer anonymity and edits, and make the out genuine.

cases.situation: A customer, Jordan, left our bakery a 2-star Google review last week because his daughter Ava's birthday cake was the wrong flavour. We called, apologised, refunded the $65 and remade it free in time for her party on Saturday. He texted today to say she loved it. Can I ask him to update the review without being pushy?
cases.reply: Hi Jordan, so glad Ava loved the cake, and thank you for giving us the chance to put it right. If you feel it's fair, you're welcome to update your Google review to mention how it was sorted; you can edit it from the same place you posted it. Completely your call, and the refund and the new cake were ours to make good either way.
cases.note: Ask only after the fix, make clear nothing depended on it, and never ask him to delete the review.

cases.situation: I'm a personal trainer. My client Denise, 58, just finished a 12-week programme and can now climb the stairs to her fourth-floor flat without stopping. I'd love a short video testimonial for my website, but she's a bit camera-shy.
cases.reply: Denise, twelve weeks ago you couldn't get up those four flights without stopping, and now you can. That's all your work. Could I ask a favour? A 30-second video on your phone would help people who are nervous about starting see that it's possible. To make it easy, you could just answer two questions: how did you feel before, and what's different now? If you'd rather write two sentences instead, or skip it altogether, that's completely fine, and thank you either way.
cases.note: For a video, give two prompt questions instead of a script, and offer a written version as a smaller out for someone camera-shy.

cases.situation: 我姓李，是自由接单的月嫂，在王姐家做了26天，宝宝从5斤多长到了8斤，今天是最后一天。我请她写段推荐语给以后的客户看，她有点为难地说：“我不太习惯在网上替人说话，不好意思啊。”
cases.reply: 王姐，完全理解，您千万别有负担。这26天谢谢您的信任，看着小宝从5斤多长到8斤，我也特别开心。以后家里有什么需要，随时找我。
cases.note: 对方婉拒就收下：道谢、不追问原因，也不换个说法再求一次。

cases.situation: 我在社区开了一间小瑜伽工作室，叫“安然瑜伽”，上周六（9月26日）刚结束一期8周的产后修复课，课程群里有12位妈妈，好几位在群里说腰疼好多了。想在群里请大家去大众点评写个评价，但不想让没空的妈妈有压力。
cases.reply: 各位妈妈，谢谢大家这8周的坚持，听到好几位说腰疼好多了，我真的特别开心。像我们这样的小工作室，新妈妈基本都是看别人的评价找过来的，如果你愿意，可以在大众点评搜“安然瑜伽”写两三句感受，一分钟就够。带娃这么忙，没空写完全没关系，谢谢大家。
cases.note: 群里只发一次、只放一个链接，不点名，也不追问谁写了没有。

cases.situation: I'm Hana and I sell hand-bound notebooks through my online shop, Paper Harbour, about 40 orders a week. I want a small printed card in every parcel asking for a review on the product page, with a QR code that goes straight there. I don't want it to feel like a demand, and I don't offer discounts for reviews.
cases.reply: Thank you for your order. Every notebook is bound by hand, and I hope yours gets filled with good things. Once you've used it for a while, a short review on the product page would help other people find a small shop like this one. The code below takes you straight there, and two sentences is plenty. Thank you either way. Hana, Paper Harbour
cases.note: A parcel card can't be timed to the good moment, so invite them back after they've used it; one link, a time estimate, a real out.

cases.situation: I'm Nico, a freelance web developer. I rebuilt the website for my friend Sara's pottery studio at a friends' rate, and since it launched last week online bookings have gone from about 5 a week to 14. I'd like a testimonial for my portfolio, but I don't want her to feel obliged or to hide that we're friends.
cases.reply: Sara, now the site's been live a week, could I ask a favour? A two or three sentence testimonial would really help me with the next few clients. Here's a draft you can edit or bin: "Nico rebuilt our studio website, and online bookings went from about 5 a week to 14 in the first week. He was quick, clear and easy to work with." I'm happy for it to say we're friends, and a no is genuinely fine and won't change a thing.
cases.note: With a friend as the client, keep the testimonial honest about the relationship and make the no cost nothing.

cases.situation: 金沢で小さな着付け教室と着物レンタルの店「はなや」をやっています（口コミのリンクは https://g.page/r/kimono-hanaya/review ）。常連の田中様が娘の美咲さんの成人式の前撮りで着付けに来てくださり、今日LINEで「本当にきれいにしてもらって、娘も大喜びでした」とメッセージをいただきました。Googleの口コミをお願いしたいのですが、押しつけがましくならないようにしたいです。
cases.reply: 田中様、うれしいメッセージをありがとうございます。美咲さんの振袖姿、本当によくお似合いでした。もしお時間があるときで構いませんので、Googleの口コミに一言いただけると、小さなお店にとっては初めての方に見つけていただく大きな手がかりになります。こちらのリンクから1、2行で十分です：https://g.page/r/kimono-hanaya/review 。もちろんお気持ちだけでも十分うれしいです。成人式当日も素敵な一日になりますように。
cases.note: 日本語では「お時間があるときで」「お気持ちだけでも」で遠慮を示しつつ、リンクは一つ、所要時間も添える。

cases.situation: I'm a wedding florist, Wildstem Flowers. I did Hannah and Luis's wedding back in June and never got round to asking for a review. Yesterday Hannah posted their wedding album and tagged us, saying the flowers were 'everything'. Our reviews page is example.com/wildstem-reviews.
cases.reply: Hannah, I just saw your album, thank you for tagging us and for saying the flowers were everything. I should have asked back in June, so I'll ask now: if you have a minute, a short review at example.com/wildstem-reviews helps other couples find us. Two sentences is plenty, and thank you either way.
cases.note: A late ask works when it hangs on a fresh good moment; own the delay in a few words and keep it to one link.

cases.situation: I'm Tom and I run a two-person kitchen fitting business. We just finished Claire Henderson's kitchen and she told me it's exactly what she'd pictured. I'd love to feature it on our website with a few photos and a line from her, but it's her home, so no faces and nothing that shows the address.
cases.reply: Hi Claire, thank you for saying the kitchen is exactly what you'd pictured; that made our week. Would you be happy for us to feature it on our website, with a few photos and a line from you? The photos would show no faces and nothing that gives away your address. To make it easy, here's a line you can edit or replace: "Tom and his team fitted our kitchen and it's exactly what I'd pictured." If you'd rather keep your home off the internet, that's completely fine. Thanks either way, Tom
cases.note: Photos of someone's home are a bigger ask than a review: say exactly what will and won't be shown, and make the no easy.

cases.situation: 我叫周凯，做企业团建策划。上周六给星河科技组织了80人的千岛湖两日团建，行政王经理今天微信说大家都很满意，还提到园区里好几家公司也在找团建。想请她帮忙推荐，但不想太功利。
cases.reply: 王经理，谢谢您特意来说！两天80个人，听到大家都满意，我们特别开心。想跟您提个小请求：您说园区里有几家公司也在找团建，方便的话把我的微信推给他们就行，不用多介绍。不方便也完全没关系，谢谢您这次的信任。
cases.note: B2B推荐请求接住对方自己提到的线索，只请她做一件很小的事，再给一个真的退路。

cases.situation: I run a small Thai takeaway, Lemongrass Lane. A regular, Mr. Evans, told us at pickup on Friday that his pad thai was cold and the order was 25 minutes late; we were short-staffed. We normally text customers our review link after an order, but I don't want to ask him for a public review. I'd like to ask him privately what else went wrong and give him his next pad thai free.
cases.reply: Hi Mr. Evans, thank you for telling us on Friday that your pad thai was cold and the order was 25 minutes late. We were short-staffed, and that's on us, not you. If anything else wasn't right, could you reply here and tell me? It comes straight to me, not to a review site. Your next pad thai is on us, whenever you next order.
cases.note: After a bad experience, swap the public review ask for private feedback, and never link the free meal to a review.

cases.situation: I run a two-hour ghost walk through Edinburgh's Old Town called Close Encounters Tours. At the end of each tour I hand everyone a small card with a QR code that goes straight to our review page, and I want a short line to say out loud as the group of about 15 heads off, without it sounding like I'm begging.
cases.reply: That's us, thank you all for braving the closes with me tonight. If you enjoyed it, the card I've just given you has a code that goes straight to our review page; two sentences takes about a minute, and it's honestly how small tours like this get found. No pressure at all, and if anything tonight didn't work for you, come and tell me now, I'd love to hear it. Safe home, everyone.
cases.note: Said aloud to a group: one place to go, how short it is, a real out, and an open door for private feedback before anyone posts in public.

cases.situation: 我是英语家教，叫Amy。初二学生小宇跟我学了一学期，期中英语从78分提到了96分，他爸爸陈先生今天微信说非常满意。想请他写两三句推荐语，放在我的朋友圈和招生海报上，但小宇是未成年人，我不想出现孩子的名字、学校和照片。
cases.reply: 陈先生，谢谢您告诉我，这学期小宇真的很用功，96分是他自己拼出来的。想请您帮个小忙：写两三句推荐语，我放在朋友圈和招生海报上，署名只写“初二学生家长”，不会出现小宇的名字、学校和照片。我先起了一段，您随意改：“孩子跟Amy老师学了一学期，期中英语从78分提到了96分。”不方便的话完全没关系，谢谢您！
cases.note: 给未成年学生的家长要推荐语：先说清楚不放孩子的任何信息，再附一段只用已知事实的草稿。

cases.situation: I'm Rosa, a mobile hairdresser who visits clients at home. I've done Mrs. Patterson's hair every fortnight for a year; she's 89 and isn't online, but her daughter Karen books and pays for the visits. Karen texted today that her mum says she 'feels like herself again' after each visit. My Google review link is https://g.page/r/rosa-mobile-hair/review.
cases.reply: Thank you, Karen, that's lovely to hear, and it's a pleasure every fortnight. If you have a minute, a short Google review from you would help other families looking for someone to visit a parent at home find me: https://g.page/r/rosa-mobile-hair/review. Two sentences about what you've seen is plenty. Thank you either way, and give your mum my love.
cases.note: When the client isn't online, ask the family member who books, and only for what they've seen themselves.

cases.situation: I'm Mei and I run a dog-walking business, Paws & Pace. Linda, whose spaniel Rufus I've walked for six months, said she'd happily leave a Google review and offered to get her husband, her sister and two neighbours to 'post five stars too to help you out'. Only Linda uses my service; my review link is https://g.page/r/paws-and-pace/review.
cases.reply: Thank you, Linda, that's really kind of you. A review from you would be lovely, since you've seen six months of walks with Rufus: https://g.page/r/paws-and-pace/review. Two sentences is plenty. I'd rather keep reviews to people who've actually used the walks, so please don't ask the others to post, but if any of them ever need a dog walker, a word from you is the best help there is. Thanks either way, Mei
cases.note: Reviews from people who never used the service mislead future customers; decline them warmly and point the goodwill at a real referral instead.

cases.situation: I'm Leah Moran and I self-published my second mystery novel, The Salt House, on Tuesday 29 September. In August, 30 people on my newsletter got a free advance copy, and several emailed to say they loved the ending. I want one email asking them for an honest review on the book's store page, example.com/salt-house; the store asks reviewers to mention when they got a free copy.
cases.reply: Hi everyone, thank you for reading The Salt House early, and to those of you who wrote to me about the ending, it made my month. The book came out on Tuesday, and if you have a minute, an honest review on its page at example.com/salt-house is how readers find a self-published book. Two or three sentences is plenty, and please mention that you got a free advance copy, since the store asks for that. Thank you either way, Leah
cases.note: Ask for an honest review, not a good one, and build the free-copy disclosure into the ask so nobody's review gets pulled.

cases.situation: 我叫林夏，开了一家两个人的UI设计工作室“木格设计”。给“青禾茶饮”做的小程序界面9月初上线，对接人是市场部的苏经理，她上周说新界面上线后线上下单多了不少。想请她同意把青禾的logo放在我们官网“合作客户”一栏，配一句项目介绍，上线前发给她确认。
cases.reply: 苏经理您好，听您说新界面上线后线上下单多了不少，我们特别开心。想跟您提个小请求：能否把青禾的logo放在木格设计官网的“合作客户”一栏，配一句“为青禾茶饮设计小程序界面”？页面上线前我会先发截图给您确认，您想改哪里我们就改哪里。如果公司对使用logo有规定，或者不方便，完全没关系，谢谢您这次的信任。林夏
cases.note: 用客户的logo比要一条评价更重：说清放在哪、写什么、上线前给她确认，并给公司规定留出口。

cases.situation: I sold my old road bike to a guy called Ollie for £320 on Swapnest, a second-hand app; he collected it on Sunday. He messaged today saying he's done his first proper ride and loves it. I'm new on the app with zero ratings, and buyers can rate sellers from the order page.
cases.reply: Really glad to hear it, Ollie, enjoy it! If you get a minute, a quick rating from the order page on Swapnest would help me a lot. I'm new on there with zero ratings so far, and that's how buyers decide whether to trust a seller. A line is plenty. Thanks either way.
cases.note: A private seller asks the same way a shop does: right after the good news, one place, how short it is, and a real out.

cases.situation: 我开了一家少儿美术工作室“小画笔”。学生乐乐学了一学期，她妈妈周姐今天微信说乐乐现在每天回家都要画画。我们有个推荐活动：朋友介绍来报名正式课，双方孩子各送一节课。想请周姐推荐给身边的家长，但不想像在推销。
cases.reply: 周姐，谢谢您告诉我！听到乐乐天天在家画画，我们老师都特别开心。想跟您提个小请求：身边如果有家长也在给孩子找美术课，方便的话把我的微信推给他们就行。顺便说一下，我们有个推荐活动，朋友报名正式课的话，乐乐和对方孩子各送一节课，您跟朋友直说就好。没有合适的也完全没关系，谢谢您一直支持我们。
cases.note: 推荐奖励要摆在明处，让被推荐的家长也知道；奖励只跟推荐挂钩，不跟评价挂钩。
